title: Less WenWenWen, more WhyWhyWhy - an Edgeware community development strategy
body:
![](https://commonwealth-uploads.s3.us-east-2.amazonaws.com/c17e5d80-7f7b-45a2-bd24-b7eed5137bb6.1662623896484)

> The parable of the Blind Men and an Elephant is a story of a group of blind men who have never come across an elephant before and who learn and conceptualize what the elephant is like by touching it. Each blind man feels a different part of the elephant's body, but only one part, such as the side or the tusk. They then describe the elephant based on their limited experience and their descriptions of the elephant are different from each other. In some versions, they come to suspect that the other person is dishonest and they come to blows… 
> [Decred - Forks in the Road](https://github.com/monsieurbulb/forksintheroad/blob/master/Decred_forks_in_the_road.md)

## Diversity is Edgeware's super power and greatest weakness.

Edgeware is a blockchain based internet organisation made up of many strangers contributing across many platforms in many different ways.

We speak _different languages_, come from _different cultures_ and bring _different perspectives_.

We create in _different forms_, we understand ideas through _different lenses_ and we prefer _different communication mediums and styles_ to make our points.

Some like _writing_, others do their talking with _code_, some prefer to tell their story via _imagery_, others speak their truth in _logos and symbols, _others find _talking_ the best way to illuminate their creativity. 

Some of us contribute under _our own names_, some _anonymously_, some _a mix of both_, some maybe even under_ a few aliases_ and others under _team or collective names_.

We utilise governance forums maintained and designed by _outside teams_, a user experience designed by those who don't _understand our specific challenges, _in a system where our _data and credentials are locked in. _
